dimensions.assessment: Affects veterans seeking educational assistance and commercial truck driving schools offering multi-state apprenticeship programs.
dimensions.evidence: multi-state apprenticeship program provided by a commercial truck driving school

dimensions.assessment: Expands administrative authority for the VA to approve certain training programs for existing educational benefits rather than creating a new benefit class.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary may act in the role of a State approving agency for purposes of approval of a multi-State apprenticeship program

dimensions.assessment: No specific federal spending amounts or budgetary changes are stated in the source text.
Amends title 38, United States Code, to grant a specific administrative approval power to the VA Secretary.
dimensions.evidence: Section 3672(c)(1) of title 38, United States Code, is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory authorization for the VA to approve such programs.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary may act in the role of a State approving agency for purposes of approval

missing_information: Number of commercial truck driving schools or veterans expected to use this approval path
Fiscal cost or savings associated with VA oversight changes
importance_detail.rationale: Authorizes the Department of Veterans Affairs to act as a state approving agency to approve multi-state apprenticeship programs provided by commercial truck driving schools for VA educational assistance.
